ideas.pitch: An AI-powered log analysis and intrusion detection dashboard that parses NGINX web server logs in real-time to surface stealthy application-layer attacks.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking track: Need for automated threat detection in modern web deployments.
ideas.title: AegisLog: Real-Time NGINX Security Anomaly Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the cybersecurity track and mirrors a proven architecture that won the UCC ACM Hackathon by delivering tangible operational utility.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight developer platform that automatically scans tabular machine learning models for demographic and feature bias, offering explainable remediation.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning track: Ensuring ethical and robust artificial intelligence systems.
ideas.title: FairCheck AI: ML Model Bias Auditor & Mitigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges value responsible AI tools; this replicates a solo-built winning entry that scored points for solving a complex ethical and technical bottleneck.

ideas.pitch: An automated monitoring platform that compares periodic satellite imagery of industrial zones to detect unauthorized land use changes and zoning violations.
ideas.problem_statement: Data Science and Analytics track: Transforming complex spatial data into actionable environmental and industrial insights.
ideas.title: GeoCompliance: Satellite Industrial Land Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines spatial data science with real-world compliance monitoring, following the blueprint of a successful runner-up project at IIIT Naya Raipur.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision pipeline that processes CCTV RTSP streams locally to detect missing PPE (helmets, vests) on factory floors and instantly alert supervisors.
ideas.problem_statement: Internet of Things (IoT) and Robotics track: Enhancing workplace safety through edge-computed sensor and visual intelligence.
ideas.title: SafeVision: Edge AI Industrial Safety Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles an immediate, high-stakes industrial safety problem with real-time video inference, matching multiple hackathon-winning architectures.

ideas.pitch: A transaction monitoring and network graph visualization tool that flags suspicious financial transfer patterns for anti-money laundering compliance.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation and Technology Solutions track: Solving complex institutional challenges using advanced data pipelines.
ideas.title: TransAction: AML Graph Risk Intelligence Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph network intelligence and explainable risk scoring, directly echoing a 1st place winning project at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.
